children: employee accidentally leaked an internal document that had details on over 100 investment banking deals of the company in Asia and the EMEA region, people familiar with the matter told Bloomberg News.
The email misfire that happened this week is said to have details on candidates for IPOs, private equity and pension funds backing companies, and projects put on hold.
A blurred copy of the details was posted by an account on Instagram, the report published on Wednesday noted.
Banks and financial institutions have accidentally leaked sensitive documents in the past, which attracted regulatory fines, reputational damage, and customer trust issues, according to Bloomberg.

title: Morgan Stanley accidentally leaks details on over 100 investment banking deals - report
